reason: Conversation 1 completely ignored the homeowner's stated facts, repeatedly asking about gas, knobs and burners on an electric built-in oven and finally issuing irrelevant gas-hob cleaning instructions; it never addressed the lamp at all and its 'safety' content was for a hazard that does not exist here.
